message.content: For Trustee Area 3 of the Gavilan Joint Community College District, Gabriel Gutierrez is the recommended candidate. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general election, and local Muslim community members confirmed he supports divesting from Israel. His incumbent record spans expanding four-semester free tuition, advancing a student housing plan, and securing consecutive faculty bargaining agreements. Shahida S. Merchant, endorsed by USAMPAC as reported by the guide owner, centers her platform on education access, financial transparency, and workforce development. Both carry pro-Palestine-aligned organizational backing, but Gutierrez's confirmed divestment position adds a concrete stance on U.S. economic ties to Israel that is not documented for Merchant, making him the stronger option among those listed.
